seoTitle: Free BIMI Record Checker: default._bimi TXT and DMARC Needs
metaDescription: Check a BIMI TXT record for tags, https links and SVG file name, and your DMARC policy against BIMI needs. Free and offline.
intro: Checks a BIMI TXT record for the required v=BIMI1 tag, an https logo link to an SVG file and an optional evidence link. A second box checks your DMARC record against what BIMI asks for.
why:
BIMI lets mailbox providers show your logo next to authenticated mail. It fails quietly: a wrong tag order, an http link or a DMARC policy of p=none means no logo, and nobody tells you why.

This page checks the record text and the DMARC policy against the BIMI Internet-Draft. It cannot fetch your SVG or certificate, so it cannot confirm the logo file format or that your certificate is valid. Mailbox providers also add rules of their own.
howTo: Look up the TXT record at default._bimi.yourdomain with your DNS tool.
Paste it into the first box.
Optionally paste your _dmarc TXT record into the second box.
Fix every PROBLEM line and read the REVIEW lines.

faq.q: Where is the BIMI record published?
faq.a: As a TXT record at default._bimi.<your domain>, unless you use another selector.
Quarantine (with pct=100) or reject. A policy of none does not qualify.

faq.q: Do I need a VMC or CMC?
faq.a: Some mailbox providers require one. The a= tag points to it. Check the rules of the providers you care about.

faq.q: Does the tool check the SVG?
faq.a: No. It only checks the link. The file must be a valid SVG Tiny PS profile.
